snippet.title: BIONICLE The Legend of Mata Nui REBUILT - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
NOTE: bit.ly/LegendNoLonger no longer functions due to a server migration on The BioMedia Project. Please use bit.ly/LegendofMataNui instead.

On The Island of Mata Nui, a great evil rises. Discover the Great Masks of Power, free the island, and fulfil your destiny.

As of August 10th, The Legend of Mata Nui REBUILT version 1.0 is now available. Though far from complete, this version marks the first step in the conclusion of a nearly 20 year saga. Expect much more in the coming months!

Download NOW at: http://bit.ly/LegendofMataNui
or automatically from within your launcher

Some notes:
• We are in no way affiliated with The LEGO Group
• This is NOT a reboot of BIONICLE G1, a continuation, or any official media
• This is NOT a new game
• What REBUILT IS, is a continuation and expansion of the cancelled Legend of Mata Nui beta project from 2001 by Saffire Corp.
• There has not previously been, and never will be any charge for LOMN or REBUILT

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Listen to Obey The Force by Paul Hardcastle here:
https://open.spotify.com/track/7hIA8J4kXWlGTLfmovr9HJ?si=6jlrCvHrRme04KwIRJAxEQ

DOWNLOAD THE SOUNDTRACK:
https://wwwbiomediaproject.com/bmp/music

#LegendNoLonger
#TheLegendRebuilt

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join our Discord chat!: http://bit.ly/LitestoneDiscord

Follow us on Facebook and Twitter for updates, or on Twitch for live streaming.

http://facebook.com/TheBeaverhouse
http://twitter.com/Vahkiti
